limits: No user input is sent. Cold observer uses CDP userGesture:false, unlike Playwright utility evaluation.
DPR1 is the explicit browser environment; owner rendering and quality settings remain untouched.
Native PNGs require human visual review; ready/frame telemetry alone cannot approve image quality.
Context/process closure is not a clean engine-dispose or remount lifecycle test.
Source and dist hashes bind observed bytes. A matching final production build log must establish source-to-build provenance.
Software GPU results do not establish physical mobile frame rate, battery, or thermal behavior.
